The code that built [the database](data.qmd#part-core) is in the authors' repository
[material-contracts]({{< var code.pipeline >}}): R and Quarto runbooks with the Python extractors and classifiers
they call. It is the working repository of the paper, not a packaged replication. The paper's Stata code has
[a page of its own](stata.qmd).

Two tools of the work have repositories of their own:

- [rGetEDGAR]({{< var code.rgetedgar >}}), the R package that retrieved the documents from EDGAR.
- [rLabelDocs]({{< var code.rlabeldocs >}}), the Shiny application the labels were given with.

## What needs WRDS

Compustat is licensed and not published. `EstiSample` marks the attachments in the paper's estimation sample, which
needs a Compustat match on `CIK` and the filing date, `DateFiled`; `SampleStepCode` and `SampleStepDesc` record the
step of the sample selection at which an attachment leaves the sample. Rebuilding the match needs a WRDS
subscription; the code is in [material-contracts]({{< var code.pipeline >}}). Neither the database nor any example on
this site needs WRDS.
